content: react-jsonschema-form (rjsf) has multiple long-standing open bugs around oneOf/anyOf: default values are not (re)applied to nested objects/arrays when switching between oneOf branches, defaults 3+ levels deep in required nested objects populate incorrectly, and default enum values inside oneOf definitions are dropped from submitted formData entirely (issue open 2+ years). Nested arrays inside oneOf branches with matching field shapes cause the wrong branch to be silently selected because auto-defaulting picks whichever branch currently validates. These are systemic problems with generic JSON-Schema-to-form generators under deep nesting + polymorphic (oneOf/anyOf) schemas, not edge cases.
